title: メディア情報論Ⅰ
subtitle: Media Informatics I
keywords: Media Information 2.Auditory and Visual Perception 3.Digitalization of Analog Information 4.Creation of Media Works
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn how media information, e.g., characters, sounds, pictures and movies, is processed and preserved in the computers. (2) learn how media information is processed in our auditory and visual systems (3) consider the correlations between the human processing and computer processing. (4) acquire basic knowledge and skill to create media contents.
advice: Students learn how the medeia information, e.g., characters, sounds, pictures and movies is encoded and preserved in the computers. Students also learn how the media information processed in the auditory and visual systems. Moreover, students consider whether the encording and decording of the media information are reasonable, in the current computers . Students acquire knowledge to use suitable encording and decording of the media information. Exercises where students create basic media works helps them to acquire basic knowlede and skill for media information. We will cover the following materials: 1. Digital encording and processing of media information, e.g., characters, sounds, pictures and movies 2. Sensation and perception process of auditory and visual systems 3. Analog signal and digital information 4. Creation of basic media works
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of binary and hexadecimal numbers.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the encording and processiong of media information in the computers.
Be able to understand the correlation between the sensation and perception and media information.
Be able to understand the way to create basic media works.
